name: Youshen Zhi Yu
source:
Protagonist Lin Xingtong, after experiencing a series of major misfortunes, prepares to end his own life.
His subconscious resistance and sorrow once again draw the attention of a deity, and ultimately, influenced by divine grace, he stops his act of self-destruction.
Upon waking again, he sees a mysterious girl, visible only to him, who calls herself Xingyu.
Xingyu claims that the deity created her in response to Lin Xingtong's longing, and that she was born for him.
However, the former also covets the latter's body and harbors great malice towards him.
Nevertheless, what is happening now still makes Lin Xingtong begin to hope for the future.
Yes, those blessed by the gods will ultimately have their wishes fulfilled. So, what is the price?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4489920/]Steam[/url]]
